title.en: Debut pop-up store at The Hyundai Seoul

summary.ja: ザ・現代ソウルで開かれたデビュー記念ポップアップ。「Hurt」のソロ版音源を初公開し、初日は浸水で開店が遅れた。
summary.en: The debut pop-up at The Hyundai Seoul, which premiered member solo versions of 'Hurt'; flooding delayed its first-day opening.

editor_note: Dates from Korean news (Economist Korea 2022-08-11); no official notice fetched. | Japanese summary changed from past-tense '開催された' to neutral '開催の' (the run extends past this record's date). | Harper's Bazaar Korea 2022-08-12 and Economist Korea 2022-08-11 read directly; no official notice fetched. / Item list, purchase limit and photo booth from Harper's Bazaar Korea (2022-08-12); dates and the flooding delay from Economist Korea (2022-08-11); no official notice fetched. detail.ja: 汝矣島のザ・現代ソウル地下2階アイコニックスクエアで8月31日まで開かれ、ADOR制作のグッズを販売した。マグカップ、マスキングテープ、キーリング、フォンケース、グリップトックからTシャツ、スウェットシャツ、エコバッグまでそろい、購入は1品目2点まで。7万ウォン以上の購入でメンバーを背景にしたフォトブースを利用できた。会場では「Hurt」のメンバー別ソロ版音源が初公開され、柱に取り付けた受話器から音楽と映像が流れた。初日は集中豪雨による漏水で10時30分の開店が延期され、現代百貨店は14時の再開を予定すると説明した。
detail.en: Running until August 31 at Iconic Square, B2 of The Hyundai Seoul in Yeouido, the pop-up sold goods produced by ADOR, from mugs, masking tape, keyrings, phone cases and grip toks to T-shirts, sweatshirts and eco bags, limited to two per product. Purchases of 70,000 KRW or more gave access to a photo booth with the members as the backdrop. Member solo versions of 'Hurt' premiered at the venue, and handsets mounted on pillars played the group's music and videos. On opening day a leak caused by heavy rain delayed the 10:30 opening, and Hyundai Department Store said it planned to reopen at 2 p.m.

editor_note: Exact pre-order start date not confirmed (the 11-22 X post links the Weverse notice); Weverse Shop notice 3180 confirms 2nd/3rd pre-order rounds shipping 2022-12-22 and 2023-01-13. | Removed from the summary: sold out right after its December 2022 release (future knowledge as of 11-22). | Notice 9982 read via WebFetch in ko and en views. detail.ja: 11月22日に公式Xで発売が案内された。「Welcome to ROOM 722!」と題し、NewJeansの寮の722号室では何があったのだろう、と呼びかけ、722号室の日常から「第1回NewJeansアワード」、新年の抱負までデビュー1年目と2023年を収めた。構成はデスクカレンダー（26ページ）、ハードカバーダイアリー（160ページ）、フォトブック（76ページ）、ステッカーパック、ミニポスター7枚、イヤーポスター、プレイングカード（フォトカード）54枚、スペシャル映像（約77分、韓英日中字幕）のデジタルコードカード、ドアハンガー、キーリング、メモパッド。Weverse Shop GLOBALで11月25日11時（KST）に予約が始まり12月7日発売、米国ストアは2023年1月31日発売で、国内販売店は後日案内とされた。
detail.en: Announced on the official X account on November 22. Under 'Welcome to ROOM 722!', it asks what went on in NewJeans' dorm room 722, covering daily life there, 'the 1st NewJeans Awards' and resolutions for 2023 from the debut year. Contents: desk calendar (26 pages), hard-cover diary (160 pages), photobook (76 pages), sticker pack, seven mini posters, year poster, 54 playing cards (photocards), a digital code card for a special video (about 77 minutes, Korean/English/Japanese/Chinese subtitles), door hanger, keyring and memo pad. Pre-orders opened on Weverse Shop GLOBAL at 11:00 KST on November 25 with release on December 7 (US store release January 31, 2023); Korean retailers were to be announced later.

detail.en: A joint pop-up with IPX (formerly LINE FRIENDS) at LINE FRIENDS SQUARE Sinsa in Gangnam, Seoul, running until June 17. detail.ja: 「Supernatural」ポップアップはソウル明洞と東京渋谷で同時に開き、入場予約はシングル発売の2時間前、6月21日11時に始まった。村上隆はNJ Tokkiと自身のフラワーを組み合わせたキャラクターとメンバー別の新キャラクター（IPXが補正）を手がけ、藤原ヒロシの手書きロゴはTシャツ、バンダナ、キャップ、バッグに使われた。明洞の事前予約は5分足らずで埋まり、村上隆のプラッシュキーリング、クッション、アクリルスマートトック、ボールペン、Binky Bong用デコパーツ、帽子、Tシャツ、バッグ、ポーチ、バッジなどを販売。初日は村上隆本人が来店し、ミン・ヒジン代表と写真に収まった。会期は7月10日までで、現地の入場予約は10時から。
detail.en: The 'Supernatural' pop-ups opened simultaneously in Myeong-dong, Seoul, and Shibuya, Tokyo, with entry reservations opening on June 21 at 11:00, two hours before the single's release. Takashi Murakami created a character merging NJ Tokki with his flower and new per-member characters (retouched by IPX), and Hiroshi Fujiwara's handwritten logos appeared on T-shirts, bandanas, caps and bags, alongside keyrings, cushions, pouches and badges. Myeongdong reservations filled in under five minutes; the shop sold Murakami plush keyrings, cushions, acrylic smart toks, ballpoint pens, Binky Bong decoration parts, hats, T-shirts and bags. Murakami visited on opening day and was photographed with Min Hee-jin. The run lasted until July 10, with on-site entry reservations from 10 AM.

summary.en: The 'Supernatural' pop-up that opened LINE FRIENDS SQUARE SHIBUYA as its first collaboration.

editor_note: Secondary sources (Fashionsnap, Time Out Tokyo). | Fashionsnap and Time Out Tokyo read directly; no NewJeans item prices found. / From Fashionsnap (2024-06-26) and Time Out Tokyo (2024-06-27), read directly; no NewJeans item prices found. Press framing removed; store address, floor area and opening hours trimmed from detail.ja for length.

detail.ja: ラインフレンズジャパンが渋谷・公園通り（神南1-19-10 PARKWAY SQUARE 2）に開業した3フロア約990㎡の旗艦店の第1弾コラボで、7月15日まで開催した。2階では日本限定の「NewJeans × Hiroshi Fujiwara」のTシャツ、バンダナ、帽子、バッグとbuniniグッズ、「パワーパフガールズ × NJ」アイテムを扱い、事前予約制の地下1階メディアゾーンでは12台のプロジェクターでMVとメンバーのコメント映像を流し、村上隆とのコラボ商品を販売した。開店前に村上隆とミン・ヒジンが来店し、村上は準備期間中、ミン・ヒジンと毎日LINEでやり取りしたと話した。営業は11時〜20時。
detail.en: LINE Friends Japan opened its three-floor flagship of about 990 square metres on Koen-dori (1-19-10 Jinnan, PARKWAY SQUARE 2) with the 'NewJeans Supernatural POP-UP' as its first collaboration, running until July 15. The second floor carried Japan-exclusive 'NewJeans x Hiroshi Fujiwara' T-shirts, bandanas, hats and bags plus bunini goods and 'Powerpuff Girls x NJ' items; the reservation-only basement media zone screened music videos and member comment videos on twelve projectors and sold the Takashi Murakami collaboration items. Murakami and Min Hee-jin visited before opening, and Murakami said he had exchanged LINE messages with Min every day during preparation. Hours were 11:00 to 20:00.

detail.en: Weverse Shop pre-orders ran from 11:00 KST until 23:59 on July 11, shipping from October 18 (global shipping available); the items were made to order and flagged as taking longer to produce and ship. Items were the BUNNIES CAMP 2024 TOKYO DOME TOTE BAG (WHITE / BLUE), T-SHIRTS (WHITE / PURPLE / BLUE / LIGHT GRAY / HEATHER GRAY), and the NewJeans x MURAKAMI BUNNIES CAMP 2024 TOKYO DOME T-SHIRTS, TOWEL and BANDANA. detail.en: Selected NewJeans x Takashi Murakami items were restocked for fans who missed the initial launch, with LINE FRIENDS SQUARE Online taking pre-orders from 14:00 until 18:00 on July 3 (KST). They were items sold from June 26 at the LINE FRIENDS SQUARE Myeongdong and Shibuya pop-ups, including plush toys, apparel and Murakami flower pieces.

detail.ja: NJZ名義の限定グッズを、ComplexCon Hong Kong（AsiaWorld-Expo、3月21〜23日）のマーケットプレイスで初日から販売した。グループは23日にNJZとして出演する予定だった。事前に公開されたデザインは、メンバーのイニシャルと「NZ」の計6種のキーリングとブレスレットで、ほかにルーズなTシャツ、ベースボールキャップ、ハンドバッグ、モバイルバッテリー、ぶら下げアクセサリー、収納バッグ、カードフォルダー、メダル、ステッカーもそろった。マーケットプレイスはHall 3・6・8・10で、一般入場は16時〜21時、マーケットプレイスのみの1日券は388香港ドル。
detail.en: NJZ exclusive merch went on sale at the ComplexCon Hong Kong marketplace (AsiaWorld-Expo, March 21 to 23) from the first day, with the group scheduled to perform as NJZ on March 23. The designs revealed in advance were a keyring and a bracelet in six variants, each member's initial plus 'NZ'; the line-up also included a loose T-shirt, baseball cap, handbag, power bank, hanging accessories, storage bag, card folders, medals and stickers. The marketplace occupied Halls 3, 6, 8 and 10, public entry ran from 4 to 9 PM, and a marketplace-only day ticket cost 388 HKD.
